# bicep

## Install

Add `rules_dx` to `MODULE.bazel`:

```python
bazel_dep(name = "rules_dx", version = "<version>")
```

Load the rules from `@rules_dx//bicep:defs.bzl`:

```python
load("@rules_dx//bicep:defs.bzl", "bicep_library", "bicep_registry_module")
```

## Rules

### `bicep_library`

Owns the Bicep files of one package for dx quality.

| Attribute | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `srcs` | `label_list` | no | Bicep and Bicep parameter files of this package. |
| `data` | `label_list` | no | Files read by load functions; not checked by dx quality. |
| `deps` | `label_list` | no | Bicep modules and registry modules this package depends on. |

### `bicep_registry_module`

A restored Bicep registry module and its cache files.

| Attribute | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `cache_root` | `string` | no | Repository-relative root of the module cache. |
| `digest` | `string` | no | sha256 of the module manifest. |
| `ref` | `string` | yes | Module reference, br:HOST/PATH:TAG. |
| `srcs` | `label_list` | no | Cached module files. |
